name: glycerin + naphazoline
uses: Uses for the relief of redness of the eye due to minor eye irritations for the temporary relief of burning and irritation due to the dryness of the eye for use as a protectant against further irritation or dryness of the eye
otcwarn: Do not use if solution changes color or becomes cloudy. Ask a doctor before use if you have narrow angle glaucoma. Stop use & ask a doctor if: you experience eye pain you experience changes in vision you experience continued redness or irritation of the eye the condition worsens or symptoms last for more than 72 hours
